prompt: Prime-time adult animated sitcom characters with simple rounded cartoon bodies, flat colour and black outlines, but every face is painted with startling real skin: pores, stubble, wrinkles, wet tired eyes, real eyelids, far more lifelike than anything around it, no feature exaggerated. Every colour is laid on in thick visible oil brushstrokes. Night, wide inside a 1930s radio studio at night: padded walls, a big chrome ribbon microphone on a stand, a blank glowing red lamp box with no writing above the door washing the walls red, a brass desk lamp: a tall skinny mayor in a bowler hat with a heavy gold mayoral chain round his neck, a long narrow face, hollow cheeks and a pencil-thin grey moustache stands small and off-centre at the chrome microphone, grinning, blank typed pages in hand, the studio washed red by the lamp box. Behind him, a tall window fills most of the frame: a snowy 1930s city at night, rooftops and chimneys, and in them hundreds of small warm lit kitchen windows, a radio mast with one red light, an ultramarine sky with a small red moon. Most of the frame cold blue and dark; the brightest values are the red lamp and the little warm windows. Plain margins with no writing. Thanks.
